| **E-8** | §2.1 (before Prop 2.6) | The displayed graph of $\varphi|_{{\rm dom}\varphi}$, $\{(x,P(x,y))\mid x\in{\rm dom}\varphi,\ y\in\Theta(x),\ \forall y'\in\Theta(x),\ P(x,y)\le P(x,y')\}$, presupposes that the infimum is **attained**.
